lines: I woke up early every single day
To chase my dreams in my peculiar way
And watched the sun descend into the night
As stars appeared in splendid silver sight
The children love to laugh and run and play
With all the things the teacher had to say
The stage grew luminous and warm and bright
As if illuminated by pure light
The great and mighty Russian czar
Could see from his tower each star
He ruled his vast domain with grace
And kept his kingdom's rightful place
She laid a green and fragrant wreath
Upon the stone that lay beneath
The story there was very bold
Of heroes from the days of old
The dinner party was a fiasco
When someone brought in Tabasco
The kitchen burned with flames most dire
And turned the building to a pyre
The actress made her grand debut
And promised fans she would renew
Her talent kept them in its thrall
And answered when her muse did call
Beneath the waves lay ancient debris
Protected by a golden key
The pirates loved to hear them mock
And tried to pick the treasure lock

With pastries that were honey sweet

On tables positioned far below
The architecture style baroque
Was something that would surely provoke
The citizens of high domain
To overthrow the current reign
The painting had a secret motif
That supported one man's belief
They sailed across the crystal lake
To witness this land they would make

A fusion of both old antique
The flowers filled the dining room
With roses in their fullest bloom
The village was seized by a plague
Though doctors' knowledge was too vague
The shepherds let their sheep to roam
Across the beach among the foam
They rented out a hotel suite
To make their vacation complete
The castle hung with clouds of gloom
Like secrets sleeping in a tomb
They sat upon the weathered porch
While flames came close enough to scorch
In this old house where heroes dwell
The sound rang out of every bell
The stars shine in the fading night,
The moon glows pale and crystal bright.
We walk together down the day,
And laugh along our winding way.
The endless sky appears so blue,
Our love remains forever true.
We stand upon the sacred ground,
Where joy and peace can both be found.
The passion burns like raging fire,
Each moment lifts our hearts yet higher.
We drift away to gentle sleep,
Where dreams run wild and dark and deep.
We dance beneath the silver moon,
The dawn will come to us too soon.
It casts a soft and gentle light,
Upon the world so warm and bright.
You hold the center of my heart,
Together we will make our start.
Your soul is gentle, good, and kind,
A precious peace within you'll find.
The waters stretch across the sea,
Their endless waves forever free.
The shoreline glimmers bright with gold,
Though winds blow fierce and ever cold.
I knock upon your chamber door,
My heart now wants you even more.
The tears fall down like summer rain,
A sorrow mixed with hopeful pain.
We gaze upon a distant star,
Though all that light has traveled far.
Within the realm of every dream,
There flows a gentle, golden gleam.
The mountains tower up so high,
Against the vast and endless sky.
The valleys rest so still and low,
Where peaceful waters gently flow.
The birds will sing their ancient song,
A melody that lasts so long.
Each rising, falling, graceful note,
Will through the golden twilight float.
The world awakes with coming spring,
And all the happy creatures sing.
The budding leaves emerge in green,
The most alive the earth has seen.
Come take my hand and let us dance,
Perhaps this is our final chance.
Together now we smoothly move,
And find within the perfect groove.
The dark and violent rolling storm,
And shapes that twist and change their form.
The thunder speaks its ancient rage,
As lightning writes upon the stage.
The autumn leaves lie cold and still,
Upon the slope of every hill.
There blows a soft and gentle breeze,
Through all the gold-lit crimson trees.
The rosy fingers draw the dawn,
As darkness is completely drawn.
The earth emerges from the dust,
And fills our hearts with sacred trust.
They place upon her weary crown,
And let it never tumble down.
She wears the joy and royal pride,
As through the halls she starts to glide.
She wandered through a world of dream
And drifted into perfect sleep
Where memories run dark and deep
Along the edge of thought's first stream
The thunder clouds release the rain
And gardens burst with blooming flowers
As nature shows its ancient powers
We gather all our hard-earned gain
My heart is breaking to its core
I feel the love that burns like fire
Your passion grows ever higher
You are the one I adore
The forge releases brilliant flames

We trace our futures in the names

Your presence burns forever bright
Forever held within my heart

Where memories stay fresh and strong
We mark each moment as we play
My heart fills up with boundless joy
With laughter echoing all around
In every smile and joyful sound
